## 2. Technical Arsenal
### Programming & Scripting:
- **Python 3**: Advanced object-oriented programming, threading, multiprocessing, async/await (asyncio), sockets, network protocols, Scapy, Requests, Cryptography, PyCryptodome, automated testing, reverse engineering scripts.
- **Shell & Systems**: Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, Kali Linux, Arch), Bash scripting, system architecture, daemon services, kernel tuning, process monitoring.
- **Web & Backend**: Modern web architecture, REST APIs, JSON APIs, secure web applications, HTTPS/SSL, CORS & CSP policies.

### Cybersecurity & Offensive Security:
- **Ethical Hacking**: HackTheBox member (@abiyeenzo), penetration testing methodologies (OWASP Top 10, network reconnaissance, privilege escalation, vulnerability exploitation).
- **Security Tools**: Nmap, Burp Suite, Metasploit, Wireshark, John the Ripper, Hydra, SQLmap, custom Python fuzzer & exploit development.
- **Defensive & Hardening**: System auditing, log analysis, firewall configuration, secure coding practices, zero-trust mindset.

## 5. Projects

### Open Source (github.com/abiyeenzo)
- **easy-language**: French-language interpreted programming language (.elg files). Interpreter written in pure C, with inline x86-64 assembly for integer arithmetic hot paths. https://github.com/abiyeenzo/easy-language
- **CVE-2025-8671**: Educational proof-of-concept for CVE-2025-8671, an HTTP/2 denial-of-service vulnerability in lighttpd. Includes a version-check mode and a controlled PoC-DoS mode, lab use only. https://github.com/abiyeenzo/CVE-2025-8671
- **qr_pointage_system**: QR-code-based attendance/check-in system. Web form for clock-in/clock-out, SQLite storage, daily Excel export, and a documented remote licensing kill-switch. https://github.com/abiyeenzo/qr_pointage_system
- **Mathor**: Python math expression interpreter. Parses `.mth` files to perform arithmetic and solve single-unknown equations, built on Sympy. https://github.com/abiyeenzo/Mathor

### Client Work (Æ Corporation)
- **MapleRoute** (in progress): Canadian Express Entry immigration support platform. CRS score calculator, personalized document checklist, 9-step journey tracker, client and staff portals. https://mapleroute.onrender.com/
- **Kaelix** (delivered): Business showcase website with a contact form backed by a database and a password-protected admin panel. https://kaelix.onrender.com/
- **La Saladerie De Claudia** (delivered): Restaurant website for a salad and bowl restaurant in Douala, Cameroon. https://la-saladerie-de-claudia.vercel.app/
- Note: some client projects intentionally have no public source code repository, at the client's request. This does not apply to the open source projects above.
